title: His saxophonist brother and his mother's address
summary: His older brother played alto sax; he gives his mother's Dumaine Street address so the interviewer can contact him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well you had a brother who played.
Yes. He was playing, he started out playing alto saxophone and I started out playing clarinet.
We both started at the same time. Older?
Well he's, I should think he's about a year and a half or two years older than I am.
Is he still in New Orleans?
He's still in New Orleans but he's not active in music anymore.
Do you have his address? If you could tell him maybe we can interview him.
Well offhand I don't know his address, I'll have to look for it. Of course I could give you my mother's house and you could always contact him from there.
Well yes, if you might put it on here.
Well okay, well if you'd contact Mrs. Alice Justin at 1429 Domaine Street. Oh yes. It's right across the street from the old San Jacinto Club.
